Question_text: Warm blooded animals need to maintain a constant internal body temperature. In cold weather some of these animals crowd together in groups. You will use test-tubes containing hot water to represent animals in an investigation into the loss of heat from animals' bodies.

You are provided with two similar shoots cut from the same type of plant. Immediately after cutting, the cut end of shoot D was placed in a beaker of water and the cut end of shoot E was placed in an empty beaker.
Fig. 3.1 shows the teeth in a human and in a dog, viewed from one side.
